nodes.title: director13 S7: a second view is built from the LAST page on screen and the ref of the card that drew it. Production's seam already did this: L.wbPrevPage and L.wbPrevRef take a paged turn's last page and lastRef, and the preselect gets avoid and avoidRef. Replayed through the seam, on the run's tree 0dd31feb1 and on Brain's replay of the lesson, c4 stuck row 18 draws the circle. The miss in director13 was the eval harness's own model of the seam. It preselected with avoid = the take of the turn's FIRST page and no ref, so after row 16 (the circle, then the card's bar) it took the circle as up. Brain's patch 016 (docs/patches/to-brain) makes the harness keep the page up as the seam does: the last page and its card ref, avoidRef to the preselect, keep and keepRef to the paged check. Reverse if a run on the patched harness and a seam replay disagree on which board is up.

director13 S8, extends dc-r7-second-view-real. A fraction-bars card whose bars name no fraction (all "?", the ask is about the bars themselves) has a second view: each bar as a circle of the same parts, its shading kept, nothing named. One bar is drawn as fraction-parts round (hideResult); two or three bars as wholes@1 circles side by side (altView "wholes", which Brain's opener already describes). c5-t02 stuck row 20, "screen par dikhao na" over e2's 4- and 8-part "?" bars, re-showed the same bars and now draws two circles of 4 and 8. Reverse if judges find the circles confuse a bars ask more than the bars.

director13, Brain's P3 turn shape on Studio's seam. A picture turn sends one requestIntent: page 1 the card's ref (Studio's preselect turns it into the second view) under the view's own line, then a segment with the card's own boardRef under the card's words. pagesBoard draws the second view, then the card, and turns at the card's first word. The result and screens[0] carry altView. The second view's page no longer runs its own card-back (that would page inside page 1 when her view line names the figure); the turn's next page is the card. Pinned on c4 stuck 18 (circle, then bar) and c5-t02 stuck 20 (two circles, then the "?" bars). Reverse if Brain sends the view and the card as separate turns.

director13's 19 picture-request rows (int/r6 6a41eb540, 2026-11-09-director13, 0-based rows) replayed through Studio's seam on claude/r4-content. Method: the turn before on its own line with its recorded pages, the preselect before her line without pages as Brain does, then the picture turn on its run text with the card's prompt and key from the run's script. 15/19 draw a second view, including both rows main cited: c4 stuck 18 draws round, c5-t02 stuck 20 draws wholes. Of the 4 without one, 3 are cards whose own board was not up yet: steady-c4 18 (the roti card under the 3/4 bar), steady-c5-t01 64, steady-c5-t02 66 (compare words). The 4th, offtopic-c4 28, drew its second view in the run itself. The harness bookkeeping, mirrored on Brain's replay (tests/fixtures/replay.mjs, no model calls), reproduces the run's miss at c4 stuck 18 with the old page-up and gives round with patch 016. c5-t02 stuck 20 needs S8 and 016. tests/r8-director13.test.mjs pins each.
